questions.question: On what calendar date was the greatest number of squirrel sightings logged during the census?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_central_park_squirrel_census_2018.csv')
top_date = str(df['Date'].value_counts().index[0])
month, day, year = top_date[:2], top_date[2:4], top_date[4:]
result = f'{year}-{month}-{day}'
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nyc_central_park_squirrel_census_2018.csv')
top_date = str(df['Date'].value_counts().idxmax())
result = pd.to_datetime(top_date, format='%m%d%Y').strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
